_doc: FireRed/LeafGreen Viridian Forest (FireRed rates): Caterpie 40%, Weedle 40%, Kakuna 10%, Metapod 5%, Pikachu 5%. mode 'both' so the bugs roam the forest visibly as well as ambushing from tall grass. Bugs are passive; Pikachu is skittish and flees. Unused until D19 adds the Viridian Forest zone: nothing loads this table yet, so it is safe to ship early.
